{{Quote|As officers of the Imperial Navy, your loyalty is ''expected''&hellip; and ''demanded''.|Darth Vader|<ref name="Republic 78" />}}
'''Imperial officers''' were members of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]].

==Description==
[[File:Vader_Officers.jpg|thumb|left|175px|A group of Imperial officers follow [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].]]
Imperial officers were members of the [[Imperial Officer Corps/Legends|Imperial Officer Corps]] that served in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]]. Many Imperial officers were drawn from the prestigious families that had a long history of military service. Trained at the various [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academies]], officers learned leadership skills, and were instructed in tactics and Imperial doctrines. Once awarded commissions and posted to active service, the officers were given chances to prove themselves in their new role. If the officers managed to distinguish themselves, they would earn promotion and begin their rise through the ranks. Very rarely were personnel from the Empire's lower-ranks elevated to the officer class.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> 

Imperial officers were admired, respected, and even feared by the personnel under their command. Officers maintained a distance from the rank-and-file of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], refusing to associate with their men unless there was an official need to. This engendered a sense of superiority within the officers, who saw themselves as inherently "better" than the common [[Soldier/Legends|soldiery]] and crewmen. Officers often felt no empathy or sympathy for the personnel under their command. For their part, the officers had no issues with being hated by their subordinates; all that mattered was they followed orders.<ref name="RPG-Core" />

The officer was a high class soldier within the Empire's military who provided a commanding presence among the legions of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] that were deployed to fight the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] enemies. Their leadership roles often inspired the troops in battle and were capable of summoning more troops onto the field.

The individuals of this class were divided into numerous special positions and placements. Despite these variations of the officer class, there was two common traits among them: ruthless ambition,<ref name="TMTS">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> and [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentrists]] who fully supported the Emperor's policy of subjugating non-human races.<ref name="Complete Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Variations==
===Security Officers===
These officers were members of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] and were responsible for monitoring as well as ferreting out signs of rebellious activity within the ranks of the Empire. Any such threats were first uncovered, arrested and eventually neutralized. This duty meant that such personnel were often known as ''"loyalty officers"'' by Imperial soldiers who were stationed at every installation; be it a remote outpost to a major facility in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]]. Their duties were the same regardless of their post and they proudly wore the gray uniform of Imperial Intelligence as well as openly admitted to their assignments. These security officers often explained the best interests of the Empire with their job requiring them to be both noticed and feared. Security officers powers allowed them to reprimand and report on individuals who were suspect with them being given broad discretion powers to ensure that an Imperial facility did not fall into rebel hands.<ref name="TTaBS">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Whilst generally open about their stations, certain officers were often assigned undercover operations at various starships or facilities. Their duty was to observe their comrades and determine which one of them posed a legitimate threat to the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. The number of agents assigned to these posts were never truly known and the fear of discovery was an effective means of preventing sedition as Imperial personnel were never sure if their comrades were security officers undercover. Though their position meant that they needed to remain in hiding, these undercover security officers were allowed to intervene when necessary. This was in cases where the tenets of the New Order were not fulfilled leading to the suspect being either reported or neutralized if need be. Those agents on starships of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] had the overriding duty to ensure that the vessel did not fall into enemy hands. The constant fear of the presence of security agents at any Imperial facility created an atmosphere of fear where personnel were required to follow the principles of the New Order or be branded a traitor.<ref name="TTaBS" />

These duties meant that they were given extensive training for their role and had to learn counter-insurgency tactics, marksmanship, untraceable execution methods and even starship engineering. All of this was designed to ensure that the officer succeeded in their mission and were even told to commit suicide rather than reveal information to their captors.<ref name="TTaBS" />

Security officers were also present on Imperial starships and battle stations to control access areas. One example was Captain Khurgee on the first Death Star.<ref name="Complete Visual Dictionary" />

===Star Destroyer Officers===
Certain officers can end up within the mighty Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] which were the backbone of the Imperial Navy. Serving aboard such vessels was an honor for the crew and officers who were selected for their skill, loyalty and leadership abilities. However, a number of officers had attained the position through political connections despite their actual talent. Regardless of entry, an officer stationed onto a Star Destroyer received a boost in their career.<ref name="TMTS" />

[[File:Imperial_Officer_TCG-CS.png|thumb|left|200px|A captain in the Imperial Navy]]
Life on a Star Destroyer for officers involved a constant state of competition due to the command structure being arranged in a manner that promoted such an atmosphere. Such individuals were often unsure of their place within their hierarchy which led to power struggles of every kind between various Star Destroyer officers. This environment was something that the higher-ranking members within the Imperial Navy cultivated as they believed that it was a desirable trait for it reduced mistakes as well as induced more careful habits from such officers. Due to the fact that Star Destroyers were often placed on assignments far from the oversight of [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]], the management of these officers was often at the discretion of the ship commander who often took liberties with their orders. This equally meant that while such assignments were coveted by the ranks of such officers, they were also feared as failure for something beyond an individual's control meant that there were at times severe forms of punishment.<ref name="TMTS" />

As such, they had the fastest promotion rate yet the worst service record and even the lowest life expectancy amongst the officer classes. This fact was well known amongst the ranks of the various officer ranks and even the military elite. These conditions meant that Star Destroyer officers were often nervous as well as insecure men who had little chance of a successful military career. Despite these problems within such assignments, the position aboard a Star Destroyer with its ruthless competition was often a beneficial placement for clever individuals. Ultimately, there was little room for mistakes or error and only those with keen minds as well as strong purpose prospered without which, an officer would be doomed.<ref name="TMTS" />

===Death Star Officers===
These individuals were the most skilled amongst their comrades and were excellent in their assignments. Following the [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolution of the Imperial Senate]], the power of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] had risen with many new benefits being available to those that managed to reach such positions. Amongst those that showed the most promise as well as ability were later taken by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] to serve on his [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] project. These young officers were devoted to the New Order and sought to rise through the chain of command.<ref name="TMTS" />

====Detention block guards====
Some officers were given command of the various detention blocks of the Death Star. One in particular, Shann Childsen, supervised the prisoners and the stationed troops at detention block AA-23, due to his opportunistic upholding of Imperial ideals, including the policy of subjugating non-human races.<ref name="Complete Visual Dictionary" />

==History==
[[File:1Blue-ImperialAcademyGraduates-Empire8DarklighterPart1.jpg|thumb|220px|[[Biggs Darklighter]] and other Imperial Officer cadets upon graduation.]]
Imperial officers were one of the many legacies of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] which passed on to the Empire. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the position of [[Republic officer/Legends|Republic officer]] was used by many high-ranking military officers that fought against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Upon the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the Galactic Empire was formed with the [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] of the Galactic Republic being transformed into the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. Thus, many officers that served the Republic became Imperial Officers while many others were trained into this position over the years of the Empire's rule.

Since the earliest days of the Galactic Empire, the position of officer had been used and certain members of this rank often participated in ground engagements alongside stormtroopers.<ref name="SWB2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> A number of officers were killed by [[Galen Marek]] during his service to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]; first as part of an act as a secret agent to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and later as a renegade when he turned against the Empire.<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> Officers also participated in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] where they fought against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel alliance]].<ref name="SWB2" /> Several Imperial officers received training at one of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academies]], such as the [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]]. Upon undergoing training, the officers, then known as cadets, endured harsh discipline, lengthy field exercises, and a rigid indoctrination into Imperial political ideology.<ref name="Complete Visual Dictionary" />

After the dissolution of the Imperial Senate and the creation of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]], a large number of the most capable and loyal officers were chosen to crew the mighty battle station under [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin's]] command. These most elite officers within the Imperial war machine were all later killed at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] which led to a number of key spots being opened within the officer corps for other ambitious individuals.<ref name="TMTS" />

During the [[Legacy era]], the position of officer remained within the Imperial military of the [[Fel Empire]].<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]].

==Equipment==
[[File:ImperialOfficer_TFU_Wii.jpg|thumb|right|125px|An Imperial Officer in full battle armor.]]
When not in a combat situation, officers wore standard issue uniforms. These uniforms consisted of a double-breasted tunic, trousers, black leather belt with code disc on the buckle, black leather boots, black leather gloves (optional) and a hat with matching [[Officer's disk/Legends|disk]]. Uniform colors varied from olive-green for naval and senior army officers to black for [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] officers, and to a lesser extent veteran TIE pilots. Small silver [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinders]] were kept in pockets on either side of the chest, near the shoulders. These cylinders were used as security permits to allow the officer to access areas under his or her authority.

All officers wear a rank insignia on their uniform. Similar to chevrons, these plaques are worn on the left side of the chest and often consist of red and blue squares. In some cases, yellow squares are present to indicate a [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] or Moff position.

If in a combat situation, officers wore a specialized armor matching their uniform color. This armor plating covered the upper torso and head. [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] commanders often wore armor close to these sets of armor. Death star troopers also wore this armor. For officers within the Stormtrooper Corps in the same situation, they instead have either orange pauldrons on the right shoulder of their armor, or otherwise have distinct markings on their armor indicating the unit they hold command over.

Imperial officers were trained to use the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]], but they also used [[SE-14r light repeating blaster/Legends|SE-14r light repeating blaster]], [[DX-2 disruptor pistol/Legends|DX-2 disruptor pistol]], [[DL-21 blaster pistol/Legends|DL-21 blaster pistol]], [[V-6d mortar launcher]]. Some could use a variant of a [[Imperial sonic blaster|sonic blaster]]. Some utilized an [[R-1 recon droid]] on the battlefield.
